WITH config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00')::numeric AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'materials_drive_url'), '') AS "materialsDriveUrl",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'payment_notify_phone'), '') AS "paymentNotifyPhone"
  FROM app_config
), candidates AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN contacts c ON c.id = s.contact_id
  CROSS JOIN config
  WHERE s.status = 'pending'
    AND NULLIF(s.mercado_pago_external_reference, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND config."mercadoPagoAccessToken" <> ''
    AND c.state = 'awaiting_payment'
  ORDER BY s.created_at
  LIMIT 20
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
SELECT s.id AS "saleId", s.contact_id AS "contactId", s.mercado_pago_external_reference AS "mercadoPagoExternalReference",
       s.mercado_pago_payment_id AS "mercadoPagoPaymentId", s.mercado_pago_preference_id AS "mercadoPagoPreferenceId",
       c.phone, c.display_name AS "displayName", config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount", config."materialsDriveUrl", config."paymentNotifyPhone"
FROM candidates x
JOIN sales s ON s.id = x.id
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = s.contact_id
CROSS JOIN config;

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS sale_id,
         $2::text AS payment_id,
         $3::text AS mp_status,
         $4::text AS status_detail,
         $5::numeric AS paid_amount,
         $6::numeric AS min_amount,
         NULLIF($7::text, '') AS extra_url,
         NULLIF($8::text, '') AS notify_phone,
         $9::jsonb AS raw_payment
), locked AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM sales s JOIN incoming i ON i.sale_id = s.id FOR UPDATE
), updated_sale AS (
  UPDATE sales s
  SET mercado_pago_status = i.mp_status,
      mercado_pago_status_detail = i.status_detail,
      confirmed_amount = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN i.paid_amount ELSE s.confirmed_amount END,
      status = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN 'paid' ELSE s.status END,
      confirmed_by = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN 'mercado_pago' ELSE s.confirmed_by END,
      confirmed_at = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN COALESCE(s.confirmed_at, NOW()) ELSE s.confirmed_at END
  FROM incoming i
  WHERE s.id = i.sale_id
  RETURNING s.id, s.contact_id, s.status, (i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount) AS approved, i.paid_amount, i.extra_url, i.notify_phone, i.raw_payment
), updated_contact AS (
  UPDATE contacts c SET state = 'paid', next_followup_at = NULL
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE c.id = u.contact_id AND u.approved
  RETURNING c.id
), cancelled_followups AS (
  UPDATE followups f SET status = 'cancelled'
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE f.sale_id = u.id AND u.approved AND f.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
  RETURNING f.id
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
  SELECT 'mercado_pago', 'payment_confirmed', 'sale', u.id, jsonb_build_object('amount', u.paid_amount, 'payment', u.raw_payment)
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE u.approved
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), queued AS (
  INSERT INTO outbox (contact_id, message_type, payload, dedupe_key)
  SELECT u.contact_id, 'payment_release', jsonb_build_object('saleId', u.id, 'amount', u.paid_amount, 'extraUrl', COALESCE(u.extra_url, '')), 'mp-release:' || u.id
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE u.approved
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), admin_notice AS (
  INSERT INTO outbox (contact_id, message_type, payload, dedupe_key)
  SELECT u.contact_id, 'payment_admin_notify', jsonb_build_object('toPhone', u.notify_phone, 'saleId', u.id, 'amount', u.paid_amount, 'customer', COALESCE(c.display_name, 'Cliente'), 'customerPhone', c.phone), 'mp-admin:' || u.id
  FROM updated_sale u JOIN contacts c ON c.id = u.contact_id
  WHERE u.approved AND u.notify_phone IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id AS "saleId", status, approved FROM updated_sale;
